notes: Single-page JSF/PrimeFaces 10 form (sections: Office contact information, New provider information, New group contract, Submitter information) ending in a PrimeFaces CommandButton 'Submit' that posts the whole form over AJAX. There is no Next; the walk ended on its only page and nothing was submitted.

Probe fix made for this capture: the Submit button carries aria-label="", which probe v2 read as an empty caption and classified 'other' instead of 'submit'. An empty aria-label now falls through to the button text, and an uncaptioned control whose id/class says submit/finish classifies as 'submit'. Navigation here comes from the fixed probe on the live page.

Rows and option lists are the probe's output from the user's Chrome (fields hash 34d1ab9c, fingerprint 7fcd6b74). Claude in Chrome truncates script output at ~1 KB, so the same probe build was replayed in jsdom over the page's static HTML and written from there after its fields hashed byte-identical to the live scan. The three 'Show Calendar' buttons exist only after the page's scripts run, so navigation was taken from the live page.

Conditional behavior (AJAX valueChange partial updates, observed 2026-10-14 by toggling answers with the user's OK; everything was reset afterwards): (1) 'Will this provider be rendering telemedicine service?' checked → reveals 'Will this provider be rendering ONLY telemedicine service?' (fingerprint 318cd02d); checking ONLY removes the provider 24/7 box and all 28 provider hour controls (62db9266). The group block behaves the same (65b4ac6d / 36ef486c). (2) '24/7 office hours?' checked → the 28 hour controls of that block stay visible but become DISABLED; a fill must not write them. (3) Degree PA or LAT → supervising physician NPI and name become required. (4) Degree APRN, CNS, LCPC, LCP, LMFT, LMLP, LMSW or LPC → reveals 'Behavioral health provider areas of expertise (select up to 10 areas)*' (see uncapturedQuestions). All 58 degrees were tried; no other degree changes the field set.

The behavioral-health list is a PrimeFaces SelectManyMenu: its native <select multiple> (#networkEnrollmentForm\:BehavioralAreasOfExpertise_input, aria-required) is 0×0 inside .ui-helper-hidden-accessible, and the scanner only special-cases SelectOneMenu, so it is skipped as zero-size. Capturing and filling it needs scanner + fill-engine support for SelectManyMenu. Its 40 options are listed in bcbs-ks-enrollment-1514e1bd8cbc.template-diff.md.

Required flags are the probe's (required / aria-required attributes): every '*' text field is required; the selects (Gender, state, Degree, Taxonomy, Specialty) report required:false although the page says 'All fields are required except where noted'. Server-side validation on them was not tested, since testing it means pressing Submit.

Both the 'New provider information' and 'New group contract' blocks are always shown with required fields. Whether a request for a provider joining an existing group can leave the group block empty is unknown without submitting.

Input masks (PrimeFaces InputMask): phones and fax (999)999-9999; ZIP 99999 and +4 9999; tax ids 999999999 (digits only — a dashed group.tin needs a digits-only transform); NPIs 10 digits; CAQH 8 digits; office hours 99:99 with separate AM/PM selects. Dates are PrimeFaces DatePickers, mm/dd/yyyy. Max lengths: names 50, address lines and city 35, middle initial 1, titles 100, emails 125, owners 500, comments 255.

Repeated labels (First name, Last name, Position / title, Phone number, Email address; the service-location block; 24/7 and the per-day hours; Taxonomy) are told apart by displayLabel. formSection is null because the markup has no fieldset or section, only styled headings.

Lists over 50 options: Taxonomy 855 (×2, bare NUCC codes), Specialty 74, Degree 58, state 50 (×2, exactly at the cap). The extension's SEND_CAPTURE and the panel's write boundary reject lists over 50 until panel PR #518 and extension PR #99 (cap 1000) deploy.
